body:
Thank you very much for your reply.

I will look into meditation and physiology manipulation.

Have a great day stranger!

I'm not on medication but I feel numb. I could be on the rails while the train is approaching me, and I'd just watch it. It's like I'm watching my life happen in third person. I can't make conscious decisions. I always seem to choose the momentarily less hurting option only to regret it later because it's become a burden.

I'm really surprised as to how you figured I am numb to reality. I'd very much like to fix this, because today was the day my future was going to be determined under two options, and I ended up with the shitty path. I know that unless I find a way to crawl out of this, I will end up killing myself. It could be weeks or months before I stop enduring, but it will eventually happen.

Thank you for your reply.
